_note: Деталь 2 — Zone 2 PEEK thermal-break sleeve (01_01 §1 + §4.1/§4.2). Frozen: bore Ø11 (= Zone-1 shaft, press-fit H7/s6), wall 2.0 mm (CTE Lamé SF 3.4×, §4.2 frozen — NOT press-fit hoop), OD Ø15 = wound in tree (CODIT <25 → DBH ≥38), length 50 mm (axial thermal break, §4.1). Plain round bore: hex anti-rotation (§4.3 C, ≤0.05 mm) is bench-gated → deferred (00_07). DIN-471 retaining grooves are on the Ti Zone-1/Zone-3 ends (§3 step 6), not the PEEK sleeve; bore stays smooth (barbs press in at 150 °C, §3 steps 4-5).
name: zone2_sleeve

notes.process: CNC from rod; anneal 200-250 C before final micromachining (else internal stress drifts the um tolerances)
notes.surface_finish: smooth round bore (hex anti-rotation 4.3 C, <=0.05 mm, is bench-gated -> deferred)
extra: Press-fit Lame-computed (HW.3.IS script 50, frozen O11/2mm, E_PEEK 4.0 GPa): contact P_c 0.49-3.32 MPa -> 0.32-2.16 at 20yr; at MIN H7/s6 fit the relaxed P_c <= sap -> the O-ring is the essential seal (PEEK backup marginal)
OD O15 = wound in tree (CODIT <25 -> DBH >=38); wall 2.0 = CTE Lame SF 3.4x (4.2 frozen), not press-fit hoop
